notes.title: Early Access V9 - Sounds and Noises
notes.content:
Added a more vibrant audio setting to the game. 
Guests, cars, cutting the kebab, the kebab grill itself and many things more now make noises.

notes.title: Early Access V8 - Challenge Mode
notes.content:
The earlier announced challenge mode is now available. 
Race against the time fulfilling the orders of a horde of customers. 
-------
Additional bug fixes:
Fixed orientation issues when frier container hits ordering queue

notes.title: Early Access V7 - Sauces
notes.content: Introducing white sauce as an additional ingredient.

notes.title: Early Access V6 - Der Gerät
notes.content:
Added new upgrade "the Gerät" an automated meetcutter famous in Germany
Fix that prevents things falling through serving area.

notes.title: Early Access V5
notes.content:
Added new soundtracks (with additional german localization).
Graphical improvements.
Resolved music sound level settings sound quality bug.
Made features less expensive to allow for faster progression.

notes.title: Early Access V4
notes.content:
Added background cars and further things to your kebab shop to make it feel more alive. 
Added german soundtrack.
